newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 312-7 AT CLOSE, AGAINST GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 312-7 AT CLOSE, AGAINST GRIQUAS.

text.p: A commanding 127 not out by Peter Kirsten steered Border to a respectable 213 for seven at the close on the opening day of their Supersport series cricket match against Griqualand West on Friday.
Kirsten has faced 268 balls in 331 minutes and hit 15 fours and offered only one chance -- a sharp return catch to Brett Benkenstein on 16.
Border lost their way in the snd half of the morning session, losing three wickets in 25 minutes to an inspired spell by seamer Garth Roe who finished the day with three for 60.
However, Kirsten put on 54 runs for the fifth wicket with Pieter Strydom, 57 for the sixth wicket with Steven Pope and 130 for the seventh with Ian Howell as Border recovered well.
Bowling: Walsh 20-0-53-1, Roe 17-3-60-3, Swanepoel 17-4-36-0, Benkestein 17-5-55-0, English 16-1-65-1, Gidley 17-5-29-2
